## Data Source & Pre-processing

The dataset for this analysis is sourced from the [AI Benchmarks vs Human Baselines](https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/kylefengkfeng209/ai-benchmarks-vs-human-baselines) repository on Kaggle. It aggregates top model scores across dozens of cognitive benchmarks and compares them to human baselines.

To ensure offline reproducibility and adhere to file size constraints, a static snapshot of the dataset was committed to `data/benchmarks.csv`. 

```{python}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
import pandas as pd
import altair as alt
from sklearn.cluster import KMeans
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler

# Load the benchmark dataset
benchmark_data = pd.read_csv("../../data/benchmarks.csv")

# Preview the data
benchmark_data[['benchmark_name', 'category', 'human_baseline', 'ai_top_score']].head()
```
